The Challenges of Running a Business in Pakistan

Pakistani businesses face a unique set of challenges, from managing complex tax laws and regulations to dealing with inefficient manual systems. The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) requires businesses to comply with various laws and regulations, including SRO 1006 and SRO 673, which can be time-consuming and costly to implement.

Manual systems can also lead to errors, lost sales, and decreased customer satisfaction. Moreover, with the increasing demand for digital payments and online transactions, businesses need to adapt to these changes to stay competitive.

That's where Phelix ERP comes in - our cloud-based POS system is designed to help Pakistani businesses overcome these challenges and streamline their operations.

How Phelix ERP's Cloud POS System Can Help

Our cloud-based POS system is designed to help Pakistani businesses manage their sales, inventory, and customer relationships with ease. With our system, you can:

  • Generate FBR compliant invoices and track your sales and expenses
  • Manage your inventory and track your stock levels in real-time
  • Analyze your sales data and make informed business decisions
  • Integrate with other systems, such as accounting and CRM software
  • Customize the system to fit your specific business needs
  • Access the system from anywhere, at any time, using our mobile app

Frequently Asked Questions

What is FBR compliance and why is it important for my business?

FBR compliance is crucial for Pakistani businesses as it ensures that your business is following the tax laws and regulations set by the Federal Board of Revenue. Our cloud POS system is FBR compliant, which means you can generate invoices and track your sales and expenses with ease, while also staying on top of your tax obligations.

How does Phelix ERP's cloud POS system help with digital invoicing?

Our cloud POS system allows you to generate digital invoices that are compliant with SRO 1006 and SRO 673, making it easy to manage your sales and expenses. You can also track your inventory, manage your customers, and analyze your sales data all in one place.

Can I customize the cloud POS system to fit my business needs?

Yes, our cloud POS system is highly customizable, allowing you to tailor it to your specific business needs. You can add or remove features, customize the user interface, and even integrate it with other systems you use.

What kind of support does Phelix ERP offer?

We offer 24/7 support to our customers, including phone, email, and WhatsApp support. Our team is always available to help you with any questions or issues you may have.

How much does the cloud POS system cost?

Our pricing plans start at PKR 10,000 per month, and we offer discounts for annual payments. We also offer a free trial, so you can try out our system before committing to a paid plan.
